review_basis: Architect r7 is implementation_ready and integrates the requested authority, bounded retention, redaction, typed legacy rejection, core rubric, namespace, version/hash, and plan-identity contracts.

blocker_dispositions.oracle: Report/log deletion, corruption, reordering, or alteration cannot affect planning, invalidation, state, or resume; state is the sole planning/resume authority.
Crash injection at publication boundaries accepts only CAS-valid authoritative state; report is a deterministic projection and cannot roll state back.

architecture_identifiers: event 33 evicts exactly the oldest entry
blocker_dispositions.oracle: 33 concurrent events retain exactly 32 newest monotonic entries, evict one oldest atomically, and preserve snapshot-only recovery; logs remain telemetry.

architecture_identifiers: only normalized repo-relative paths, stable IDs, and hashes cross durability
blocker_dispositions.oracle: Absolute, traversal, symlink, token, raw argv, prompt, and exception inputs produce no forbidden durable/log values; unsupported references fail closed.
Legacy values nested in typed/persisted fields reject before planning; legacy words in aliases, prompts, manifests, discovery, or untyped metadata do not trigger handling.

architecture_identifiers: bundle metadata never grants permission or remaps model roles
blocker_dispositions.oracle: Reserved-key/namespace collision, schema/hash drift, permissive override, altered rubric, or plan mismatch fails closed; core rubric, safety, routing, leases, and identity remain authoritative.

reconciliation_hook_dispositions.evidence: D7C authority and resolver schemas define EffectiveConfigResolver.v1, state/report roles, source/identity hashes, atomic publication, CAS, and projection semantics.
reconciliation_hook_dispositions.oracle: Missing/stale/altered report is non-authoritative and cannot change resume.

reconciliation_hook_dispositions.evidence: Architecture non-negotiable explicitly requires latest 32 monotonic events and event 33 exact oldest eviction; telemetry-only logs and recovery boundaries are specified.
reconciliation_hook_dispositions.oracle: Concurrent 33+ event run is bounded at 32 with monotonic survivors and snapshot-only recovery.

reconciliation_hook_dispositions.evidence: Redaction precedes every durability boundary; only normalized repo-relative paths, stable IDs, and hashes cross it; AF-1 applies before parse/persist.
reconciliation_hook_dispositions.oracle: Traversal/symlink/outside paths and secrets/raw inputs never persist or authorize.

reconciliation_hook_dispositions.evidence: C10 defines core SituationalRubricRegistry/v1, eight dimensions, deterministic aggregation/rationale, and namespaced extension validation/hashes.
reconciliation_hook_dispositions.oracle: Bundle cannot replace rubric or alter aggregation/rationale; collisions fail closed.

reconciliation_hook_dispositions.evidence: D3-A rejects legacy tiers before planning with typed nested/persisted values; unsupported schemas fail closed and no compatibility alias/deprecation path exists.
reconciliation_hook_dispositions.oracle: Mixed-version/legacy ambiguity has typed reject, never heuristic downgrade.

reconciliation_hook_dispositions.evidence: Manifest, catalog, inventory, selection, mapping, fallback, invalidation, rubric/dimension, and plan identities are hash-bound; resolver result is shared by all entrypoints.
reconciliation_hook_dispositions.oracle: Bundle swap, rubric downgrade, report replay, or plan substitution cannot resume.
